sm_top.sm: The IRGC claimed responsibility for tanker explosions and the downing of a drone in the Strait of Hormuz.
Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu closed the West Bank following a thwarted potential major attack.
Reports indicate an apparent airstrike against Pickaxe Mountain and other targets in Iran is underway.
Houthi missile and drone attacks targeting Riyadh airport and surrounding areas resulted in casualties and interceptions over multiple days.
US forces conducted airstrikes on Iranian military sites on Qeshm Island, causing multiple explosions.
The United States considered ending annual military aid to Israel.
The death toll from a Russian strike on an aid center in Komyshuvakha has risen to 43.
Iran claimed it downed a US drone over the Strait of Hormuz.
Multiple oil tankers and a tug caught fire in the Strait of Hormuz and off the coast of Oman after being struck by projectiles or mines.
Russia launched hundreds of missiles and drones targeting Ukraine's energy infrastructure.
Ukraine reports a deadly Russian double-tap bombing on a village, resulting in at least 40 deaths.
US forces conducted strikes on Iranian targets along the Strait of Hormuz.
Ukrainian drones struck the Ryazan oil refinery and a logistics hub, causing fires and one injury.
Kyiv authorities report water supply disruptions following Russian strikes on energy infrastructure in the Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions.
The death toll in the Houthi missile attack on Riyadh Airport rose to 14 after a second Indian national died from injuries.
The death toll from a Russian airstrike on Komyshuvakha has risen to 43.
The WHO chief reported that attacks in Ethiopia have killed civilians and brought the health system near collapse.
Ukrainian air defenses intercepted 105 of 128 Russian drones and missiles in an overnight attack.
A Houthi missile strike on a military training camp in Al-Dhalea leaves casualties.
A Russian strike hit a dry cargo ship near Odesa.
Russian attacks hit Ternopil and Rivne oblasts, targeting a residential building and an energy facility.
A Houthi missile attack on a military camp in Yemen resulted in 13 deaths.
Police report 42 bodies recovered from rubble following a Russian strike on the village of Komyshuvakha.
Russian MoD claims strikes on Kharkiv infrastructure, including a thermal power plant and a drone assembly warehouse.
The Gaza Government Media Office reported 1,593 killed and 5,748 injured in Israeli ceasefire violations.
Saudi-led coalition airstrikes in Yemen killed at least 12 civilians, including six children, with a total death toll reaching 24.
Russian strikes have forced Ukrainian nuclear power plants to reduce their electricity generating capacity.
President Zelensky condemned a Russian attack on a school that resulted in at least 40 deaths.
Ukrainian air defenses destroyed over 8,000 aerial targets during October 2026.
Russian drone strike on aid centre in Komyshuvakha kills 40, 30 missing
Bodycam footage shows a deadly attack on a Ukrainian school shelter.
Russia follows the bombing of a Ukrainian aid centre with combined attacks on hospitals and hospices.
Russia fired 310 drones at Ukraine in an overnight attack, while the death toll from the Komyshuvakha strike rose to 37 and two people were injured in the Odesa region.
The Ethiopian Human Rights Commission reports that an armed attack in Southeast Oromia resulted in 48 deaths.
North Korea conducted tests of its air defenses and airfield strike capabilities.
North Korea tested a cruise missile featuring a dispersal warhead.
Polish officials stated that a border group withdrew into Kaliningrad after a night alert, with Prime Minister Tusk noting a possible provocation was thwarted.
Algeria sent troops to Niger as a warning for Morocco and Israel.
Cyberattacks hit supermarket refrigeration systems and blood storage facilities across European nations, spoiling food supplies.
European nations plan to hold a joint military exercise in Poland in support of Ukraine.
